mapper.sql: CASE WHEN all_types LIKE '%CASH%' AND all_types LIKE '%CARD%' THEN 'MIX' WHEN all_types = 'CASH' THEN 'CASH' WHEN all_types = 'CARD' THEN 'CARD' WHEN all_types = 'MIX' THEN 'MIX' ELSE 'DIVIDE' END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments (store_id, order_id, place_id, payment_amount, discount_amount) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{orderId}, #{placeId}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount})
mapper.select:
SELECT pay.payment_id, pay.payment_amount, pay.discount_amount, pay.created_at, place.place_name,
-- (메뉴 이름과 수량) GROUP_CONCAT (DISTINCT CONCAT('메뉴: ',M.menu_name, ' ', '수량: ',OM.order_item_quantity, ' 가격: ', M.price) SEPARATOR ', ') AS menu_list,
AS payment_type
FROM ( SELECT p.*, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pd.payment_type ORDER BY pd.payment_type SEPARATOR ',') AS all_types FROM payments p JOIN payment_detail pd ON p.payment_id = pd.payment_id WHERE p.payment_id = #{paymentId} GROUP BY p.payment_id ) pay JOIN places place ON pay.place_id = place.place_id JOIN orders O ON pay.order_id = O.order_id JOIN order_menus OM ON O.order_id = OM.order_id JOIN menus M ON OM.menu_id = M.menu_id
